thesis: Luca Ferrari describes Bending Spoons as a hybrid entity that is 25% private equity and 75% technology company, which acquires digital businesses to own and operate them forever rather than selling them after a few years. Unlike traditional private equity, Bending Spoons performs extensive deep work to rethink and rebuild every part of acquired companies, including rewriting software, rearchitecting cloud infrastructure, and redesigning user interfaces to close the gap between the status quo and a vision of the most successful version of the business.
